execution_policy.notes: The user approved direct Debug and Release x64 compile checks, official dependency retrieval, isolated portable application execution, synthetic media and plugin scripts, bounded lifecycle/resource testing, and scratch release-equivalent packaging. Approval does not cover the hard-coded A: release scripts, live updates, release publication, real user media, or unrelated external tools. Re-approved by the owner on 2026-09-05 after migration to 2026.09.04-unified.9: all five gate command arrays, source bindings, and cautions verified identical to the pre-migration record.

notes: Windows host with MSBuild 18.8.2, Visual C++ v143, Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0, and .NET Framework 4.8 reference assemblies.
Source/packages and the prepared Source/bin Apps tree were absent before the first dry run.
An isolated worktree passed x64 builds after an official NuGet.org restore and staging three headers from VapourSynth R79 commit acabf605b2205b32d65859bb2736405719d2fafd.

The integrated portable candidate passed GUI startup/source fixtures, 5,000 lifecycle iterations per engine, and a full scratch archive gate that took 1,038.3 seconds and about 10.3 GiB private memory.
avoid_locally: network restore outside an explicitly approved isolated worktree
